description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific hardware upgrade checks and procedures for embedded devices within the OpenWrt firmware project. It defines methods to check the integrity of upgrade images and to perform the upgrade process, selecting different behaviors based on the device type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image file based on device-specific criteria such as board name and magic word.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process, selecting the appropriate upgrade method based on board specifications.
